messages:
deploy-bot: Started migration `add_user_preferences_col` on prod for release v3.14. Rolling out to 10% tenants. Canary holdpoints at 10% and 50%. Watch: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1769999001 — pinging @sre-oncall for monitoring.

alice: watching the canary now. i'll keep an eye on lock_wait and replication lag.

bob: pinning app-service to `v3.14-canary` for the 10% window, will hold for 10m. if error rate > 1% we rollback.

trent: seeing small bump in lock_waits — `pg_stat_activity` shows ~12 waiting, avg wait ~180ms. CPU and IO look normal.

maria: backfill worker queue length x3 vs baseline, throughput slightly reduced. batch_size default? did we change batching?

trent: grep of logs shows recurring: `ERROR: could not obtain lock for relation 23456` from `repo/migrations/245_apply.go:89` — repeating every ~30s.

alice: pause at 10% holdpoint. if we observe continued lock errors for >5m -> abort. issuing pause now.

deploy-bot: Migration paused by @alice at 1769999123. Canary holdpoint engaged. To resume run `/deploybot resume 1769999001` (requires approvers).

sre-oncall: agree with pause. rollback options: 1) abort migration and roll back schema; 2) resume with reduced batch size + throttle. Thoughts?

bob: prefer throttled resume first (avoid full rollback). propose `batch_size=30` and `throttle=700ms`. revert plan ready if lag or errors spike.

trent: starting a controlled resume with `batch_size=30 throttle=700ms` — resumed at 1769999200, watch logs for lock errors.

maria: queue draining slower but steady, no new `could not obtain lock` errors in last 2m. throughput ~0.8x but stable. monitoring dashboards updated.

alice: switching to staged rollout. pin app-service for next 2h to `v3.14-canary` to avoid automatic client upgrades. also creating followup ticket INF-9123 for backfill tuning.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: app-service -> `v3.14-canary` by @bob. Rollback command: `/deploybot rollback 1769999001` if needed.

dawn: adding a note to release notes: "DB migration may cause short-lived row-level lock contention; backfills will be throttled." will PR in docs.

alice: postmortem owner: @alice. next steps: run synthetic queries against pinned canary tenants, schedule slow backfill job during off-peak (02:00-05:00 PT), and update runbook with `batch_size`/`throttle` knobs. :thumbsup:

bob: thanks all — holding on-call for 2h, will rollback if error rate or replica lag exceeds thresholds in runbook.

trent: logging: snippet of recent errors for postmortem: `2026-01-24T15:12:34Z ERROR repo/migrations/245_apply.go:89 could not obtain lock for relation 23456` — saving for INF-9123.

maria: I'll follow up in INF-9123 with backfill metrics and a recommended `throttle=500ms` profile based on worker throughput tests.

alice: closing thread for now, keeping monitoring open. update in 30m or earlier if anything changes.
